import awkward as ak


class DimuonAnalyzer(BaseProcessor):
    def object_preselection(self, data):
        """Build MuonGood collection: pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = data.Muon
        muon_good = muons[

        ]
        data["MuonGood"] = muon_good
        return data

        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        data["n_muons"] = ak.num(data.MuonGood)

```python
from pocket_coffea.processor import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak


class DimuonAnalyzer(BaseProcessor):
    def object_preselection(self, data):
        """Build MuonGood collection: pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = data.Muon
        muon_good = muons[
            (muons.pt > 15) & 
            (abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        ]
        data["MuonGood"] = muon_good
        return data
    
    def object_selection(self, data):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        data["n_muons"] = ak.num(data.MuonGood)
        return data
```
